text.en:
The name of the Concepcion Elementary School Unit I located at J.P. Rizal Street, Barangay
Concepcion, Municipality of Marikina, Metro Manila, is hereby changed to H. Bautista Elementary School in
honor of one of the heroes of the Philippine Revolution, General Hermogenes "Menes" Bautista.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
